mentions.name: PeekCard
mentions.description: A simple free iOS app that scans almost any barcode, stores the scanned codes in the app, and can add them to the home screen via a widget. It has no tracking and no subscriptions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The result of that: PeekCard - https://peekcard.app

A simple iOS app for scanning (almost any) barcode and storing in the app, or adding it to your home via a widget. No tracking, no subscriptions, just a simple free app that is pretty simple to use and does the one thing I want it to do.
